query_text: Is EGFR typically upregulated or downregulated in lung adenocarcinoma?

ground_truth.answer: EGFR is frequently upregulated in lung adenocarcinoma, with overexpression observed in 40-80% of cases depending on the cohort and detection method.

query_text: What are the most common phosphorylation sites on ERK1/2?

ground_truth.answer: The critical activating phosphorylation sites are Thr202/Tyr204 on ERK1 (MAPK3) and Thr185/Tyr187 on ERK2 (MAPK1), phosphorylated by MEK1/2.
